findings: Direct archive directory lists both v1465680977_2 and _5 detached labels and QUB files. Both unchanged raw downloads are retained with hashes. The volume index selected _5; that index is not an exhaustive directory version inventory.

Detached labels share PRODUCT_ID 1_1465680977.13981, instrument start/stop times and CORE_ITEMS (48,352,48), but _2 is labelled FINAL and _5 PRELIMINARY. Suffix number alone is not chronological or scientific priority.

The _2 detached label reports MISSING_PIXELS 0, versus 12288 for _5. Checksums, creation times, clock-stop and housekeeping metadata also differ. These are publisher claims, not an independently decoded missing-sample count.

Whole raw files differ. The equally sized trailing regions beginning at the one-based QUBE pointer 24065 have 21999 differing bytes in 2884 contiguous runs. This establishes nonidentity beyond the header, without independently assigning differences to core samples or suffix housekeeping.
Both downloaded QUB files are 1751552 bytes; FILE_RECORDS 3422 times RECORD_BYTES 512 declares 1752064 bytes, 512 more. Cause remains open and no padding, repair or truncation applied.
Detached DATA_SET_ID CO-E/V/J/S-VIMS-2-QUBE-V1.0 remains distinct from embedded original-header CO-S-VIMS-2-EDR-V1.0. Metadata representation and later attached ISIS labels are not byte identity.
Archive errata are historical statements, including calibration-review status at DVD creation; they do not establish present-day calibration status or explain this record-count discrepancy.
